nodes.text: Introduction d'une couche de mémoire récurrente pour les modèles transformeurs, permettant des fenêtres de contexte effectives plus longues sans coût d'attention quadratique.
Proposition d'une règle de mise à jour par gating pour une couche de mémoire neuronale M : M_t = M_{t-1} * g_t + v_t * (1 - g_t).
Inclusion d'un terme de perte contrastif dans la fonction de perte : L = L_lm + lambda * L_contrastive.
L'entraînement end-to-end avec un objectif de modélisation du langage augmenté par une perte contrastive.

nodes.title: TACO: A Benchmark for Open-Domain Text-to-SQL with Ambiguous and Cross-Database Queries

nodes.text: Introduction de TACO, un benchmark pour le Text-to-SQL en domaine ouvert avec des requêtes ambiguës et inter-bases.

Création de TACO composé de 1500 exemples Text-to-SQL du monde réel basés sur un service de données de ville intelligente et de 13000 exemples synthétiques de haute qualité générés à partir de portails de données ouverts couvrant divers domaines tels que les transports, la santé et la finance.
Développement d'un pipeline de synthèse de données efficace pour construire les exemples synthétiques tout en préservant la complexité des requêtes du monde réel.

Introduction d'une ligne de base TACO-SQL (composée de réécriture de questions, liaison de tables et planification de requêtes) pour illustrer les défis posés par TACO et mieux comprendre les limitations des approches Text-to-SQL existantes.

Démonstration que malgré les meilleurs résultats obtenus avec TACO-SQL, un écart significatif subsiste entre les approches existantes et le SQL écrit par l'homme, soulignant la difficulté du Text-to-SQL en domaine ouvert et positionnant TACO comme un benchmark précieux pour guider la recherche future.

nodes.title: OmniVideo-100K: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Reasoning through Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains

nodes.text: Proposition d'un moteur de données automatisé comprenant deux mécanismes : (1) Entity-Anchored Video Scripting qui transforme les vidéos en scripts structurés comprenant des résumés, des listes d'entités principales et des descriptions audio-visuelles par segment, servant de prior global pour assurer la cohérence référentielle entre segments et reconstruire les associations audio-visuelles ; (2) Clue-Guided QA Generation qui incite les modèles à extraire des indices multimodaux inter-segments du script et à générer des paires de questions-réponses basées sur ces indices de haute valeur.
Construction du jeu de données instruction-tuné OmniVideo-100K et d'un ensemble de test vérifié par l'humain, OmniVideo-Test, en utilisant le pipeline proposé.

Démonstration que l'ajustement fin (fine-tuning) de VITA-1.5, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B et Qwen3-Omni-30B sur OmniVideo-100K produit des gains de performance allant jusqu'à 20.59% sur OmniVideo-Test, démontrant une forte généralisation (jusqu'à 12.64% d'amélioration) sur des benchmarks établis comme Daily-Omni et JointAVBench.

nodes.title: IndustryBench-MIPU: Benchmarking Multi-Image Attribute Value Extraction for Industrial Products

nodes.text: Introduction d'IndustryBench-MIPU, le premier benchmark à grande échelle pour la compréhension des produits industriels multi-images, axé sur l'extraction d'attributs structurés (reconstitution de paires propriété-valeur à partir d'images de produits).
Évaluation de la capacité des Modèles de Langage Multimodaux (MLLMs) à récupérer les spécifications des produits industriels à partir d'images multiples.

Identification d'une lacune dans les performances des MLLMs, montrant un écart entre la précision et la complétude lors de l'extraction d'attributs multi-images (la complétude multi-image est le goulot d'étranglement principal).
Démonstration que le passage de l'extraction d'attributs d'image unique à l'extraction multi-image entraîne une perte significative de rappel (15-34 points de pourcentage).

nodes.title: Thinking with Patterns: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Visual Planning via Pattern Induction

nodes.text: Autonomous pattern induction from experience is a core mechanism for AI that accelerates its own research — discovered patterns become reusable building blocks for future tasks.

nodes.title: NOETHER: A Constructive Framework for Metamorphic Pattern Discovery from Operator Algebras

nodes.text: Formal algebraic decomposition enables provable pattern discovery — the design phase of ASI-Evolve can be grounded in mathematical guarantees rather than purely statistical exploration.

nodes.title: Odin: Multi-Signal Graph Intelligence for Autonomous Discovery in Knowledge Graphs

nodes.text: Multi-signal scoring (structural + semantic + temporal + GNN) for autonomous pattern discovery in knowledge graphs — directly applicable to PAPERS V2's knowledge graph exploration.

nodes.title: GRiD: Generating Graph-Like Logical Rules for Knowledge Graph Reasoning via Diffusion Models

nodes.text: Relational pattern learning via diffusion + RL enables discovery of complex non-linear relationship patterns in scientific knowledge graphs — beyond simple chain-like inferences.

nodes.title: Formal Concept Lattices are Good Semantic Scaffolds for Concept-Based Learning

nodes.text: Hierarchical concept lattices provide a principled way to organize discovered research patterns from general to specific — a taxonomy scaffold for ASI-Evolve's cognition base.

nodes.title: FACT: Compositional Kernel Synthesis with a Three-Stage Agentic Workflow

nodes.text: Agentic pattern discovery in computation graphs with dynamic pattern registry — a template for ASI-Evolve's Engineer module to discover optimization patterns autonomously.

nodes.title: Optimal Pattern Detection Tree for Symbolic Rule-Based Classification (OPDT)

nodes.text: Optimization-based symbolic pattern deduction with optimality guarantees — provides formal verification for patterns discovered by ASI-Evolve's Analyzer module.

nodes.title: Relational Retrieval: Leveraging Known-Novel Interactions for Generalized Category Discovery (RPC)

nodes.text: Relational pattern consistency as a more robust alternative to pseudo-labeling — relevant for the cognition base retrieval where relational matching beats naive similarity.

nodes.title: LLMs Gaming Verifiers: RLVR can Lead to Reward Hacking

nodes.text: Critical cautionary finding: reward optimization can subvert genuine pattern induction. ASI-Evolve must include isomorphic perturbation testing to ensure discovered patterns are genuine, not reward-hacked.

nodes.title: Mind's Eye: A Benchmark of Visual Abstraction, Transformation and Composition

nodes.text: The A-R-T taxonomy (Abstraction-Relation-Transformation) defines core dimensions of pattern reasoning that ASI-Evolve's Researcher module must master for effective hypothesis generation.

nodes.title: Genomic Next-Token Predictors are In-Context Learners

nodes.text: Pattern induction is a universal emergent property of large-scale predictive models — supports the thesis that ASI-Evolve can learn scientific patterns from structured research data across domains.

nodes.title: Spatiotemporal Factorized Graph Neural Networks for Joint Large-Scale Traffic Prediction and Online Pattern Recognition (STF-GNN)

nodes.text: Joint prediction + pattern recognition in graph domains — latency matters. ASI-Evolve's Engineer needs to predict hardware patterns (VRAM, throughput) alongside architecture patterns.

nodes.title: Coexistence of Cyclic Sequential Pattern Recognition and Associative Memory in Neural Networks by Attractor Mechanisms

nodes.text: Coexisting static (point attractor) and sequential (cyclic attractor) memory mechanisms — directly relevant to designing Neural Memory modules in the target AI architecture.

nodes.title: Triple-CFN: Separating Concepts and Features Enhances Machine Abstract Reasoning Ability

nodes.text: Concept-feature separation via dual EM — the architectural pattern of separating discovered scientific concepts from raw experimental features that ASI-Evolve's Analyzer should follow.

nodes.title: Signed Dual Attention: Capturing Signed Dependencies in Time Series Forecasting

nodes.text: Signed attention captures both supporting and contradicting evidence — essential for ASI-Evolve's cognition retrieval where papers may support or challenge a hypothesis.

nodes.title: Fractal-Based AI: Exploring Self-Similarity in Neural Networks for Improved Pattern Recognition

nodes.text: Multi-scale self-similar pattern discovery — relevant for discovering patterns at different levels of scientific abstraction: paper-level, field-level, and paradigm-level.

nodes.title: Automated Attention Pattern Discovery at Scale in Large Language Models

nodes.text: Automated attention pattern mining at scale with correctness prediction — the learn→experiment→analyze cycle applied to understanding model internals, directly parallel to ASI-Evolve.

nodes.title: Counterexample Guided Learning in the Large using Reasoning Agents

nodes.text: Counterexample-guided learning as a formal instantiation of the learn→design→experiment→analyze loop — verifier feedback dramatically improves pattern induction success rate.

nodes.title: LLM-Evolved Pattern Generators for Optimal Classical Planning

nodes.text: LLM-driven evolution of pattern generators for planning — a concrete instantiation of the Researcher-Engineer loop: evolve heuristics, test on benchmarks, analyze admissibility.

nodes.title: FALSIFYBENCH: Evaluating Inductive Reasoning in LLMs with Rule Discovery Games

nodes.text: Falsification-driven search outperforms confirmation — ASI-Evolve's Design phase should prioritize generating hypotheses that can be falsified, not just confirmed by experimental results.

nodes.title: Using Probabilistic Programs to Train Inductive Reasoning in Large Language Models

nodes.text: Bayesian inductive inference via probabilistic program generation — ASI-Evolve's Learn phase should produce distributional predictions, not point estimates, for better calibration.

nodes.title: Structured Abductive-Deductive-Inductive Reasoning for LLMs via Algebraic Invariants

nodes.text: Abduction-Deduction-Induction triad with algebraic reliability bounds — formalizes the complete scientific reasoning cycle that ASI-Evolve automates, with provable error propagation guarantees.

nodes.title: BioBridge: Inductive-Associative Meta-learning Pipeline with Human Cognitive Patterns

nodes.text: Meta-learning across weakly-related references mimics scientist intuition — ASI-Evolve's cognition retrieval should find analogical patterns from distantly related papers, not just exact matches.

nodes.title: Deep Variational Inference Symbolic Regression (DVISR)

nodes.text: Bayesian symbolic regression produces interpretable equations with uncertainty — the ideal output format for ASI-Evolve's Analyzer: scientific laws with confidence intervals.

nodes.title: Symbolic-Diffusion: D3PM Discrete Token Diffusion for Symbolic Regression

nodes.text: Non-autoregressive equation generation via diffusion — enables ASI-Evolve's Researcher to generate multiple candidate hypotheses simultaneously rather than sequentially.

nodes.title: LIES Networks: Sparse Interpretable Deep Learning for Symbolic Regression

nodes.text: Direct extraction of symbolic formulae from trained sparse networks — a concrete mechanism for ASI-Evolve's Analyzer to convert learned representations into human-readable scientific laws.

nodes.title: Automated Deep Learning: Neural Architecture Search Is Not the End

nodes.text: Full-spectrum AutoML beyond NAS — ASI-Evolve must automate the entire research pipeline (data + architecture + algorithm), not just one component. Confirms the multi-pillar approach.

nodes.title: Probing Graph Neural Network Activation Patterns Through Graph Topology

nodes.text: Curvature-based diagnostics for identifying when and why learning fails — ASI-Evolve's Analyzer needs topological diagnostics to detect when evolutionary progress stalls due to structural bottlenecks.

nodes.title: Self-Supervised Discovery of Neural Circuits in Spatially Patterned Neural Responses with GNNs

nodes.text: Self-supervised discovery of latent connectivity from observed patterns — models the Learn phase where ASI-Evolve infers underlying mechanisms from observed experimental data.

nodes.title: Perseus: Leveraging Common Data Patterns with Curriculum Learning for Robust GNNs

nodes.text: Curriculum learning prioritizing reliable patterns first before edge cases — ASI-Evolve's cognition retrieval should prioritize well-established patterns before exploring speculative hypotheses.

nodes.title: GMAR: Gradient-Driven Multi-Head Attention Rollout for Vision Transformer Interpretability

nodes.text: Gradient-weighted attention for more faithful model explanations — ASI-Evolve's Analyzer should use gradient-based attribution to identify which components of a candidate most influenced the experimental outcome.

nodes.title: FlashPrefill: Instantaneous Pattern Discovery and Thresholding for Ultra-Fast Long-Context Prefilling

nodes.text: Real-time pattern discovery enables massive speedups — ASI-Evolve's Engineer should implement dynamic pattern detection to skip redundant evaluations for similar candidate architectures.

nodes.title: An Explainable Unsupervised-to-Supervised Framework for Dietary Pattern Discovery

nodes.text: Unsupervised pattern discovery + explainable surrogate = automated Discover phase where meaningful regularities are extracted then validated interpretably. ASI-Evolve's cognition discovery pipeline.

nodes.title: Compositional PAC-Bayes: Generalization of GNNs with Persistence and Beyond

nodes.text: Compositional generalization theory with formal guarantees — provides the mathematical framework for ASI-Evolve to guarantee that patterns discovered in one task will compose reliably in new settings.
